comment: Power menu for the S10+ (beyond2lte), installed to /etc/nuxel/power/power-menu.json. Single source of truth for the long-press POWER menu. The graphical Settings power surface (pwa/nuxel-apps/settings/power-menu.js), the console (nuxel-power-diag.sh menu) and the hardware-button FSM all read THIS table, so a finger tap and a console command can never disagree. Entries with dispatch=userspace are executed only by nuxel-button-manager through the reboot gate; Recovery/Download Mode remain refused by NO_FLASH_INVARIANT.

entries.label: Cancel
entries.note: Dismisses the menu; the safest default selection. Never a reboot path.

entries.label: Lock screen
entries.note: Locks the launcher and blanks the panel through nuxel-pwa-host -> nuxel-wl-fb. Reversible by a POWER short press (or the on-screen unlock swipe).

entries.label: Take screenshot
entries.note: Captures the composited frame (wlr-screencopy, never /dev/fb0) and writes a PNG into /home/nuxel/Gallery so the Gallery app indexes it.

entries.label: Restart
entries.refusal_reason: refused by reboot-gate.json (disabled, not allowed, cooldown or hourly cap)
entries.note: A restart must return to Nuxel. The gate enforces a cooldown and an hourly cap; after three failed returns, stop rebooting and change diagnostic strategy.

entries.label: Power off
entries.refusal_reason: refused by reboot-gate.json (disabled or poweroff not allowed)

entries.label: Reboot Verbose
entries.note: Writes the one-shot verbose flag before the reboot, for THIS boot only.

entries.label: Safe Mode
entries.note: Writes the one-shot safe-mode flag before the reboot, for THIS boot only.

entries.label: Reboot Diag
entries.note: Writes the one-shot diag flag before the reboot; the early boot stage runs the diag pack.

entries.label: Reboot Debug
entries.note: Writes the one-shot debug flag before the reboot, for THIS boot only.

entries.label: Back
entries.note: Launcher Back: app history -> in-app back -> Home.

entries.label: Stop loading
entries.note: Stops the foreground PWA document load.

entries.label: Reload launcher
entries.note: Reloads the launcher document only; never terminates the launcher process.

entries.label: Recovery (Samsung)
entries.refusal_reason: NO_FLASH_INVARIANT — entering Recovery means leaving Linux for the Samsung bootloader. This mission triggers no bootloader interface of any kind.
entries.note: The entry exists so the menu is honest about the device's capabilities; it is offline-tested as a REFUSAL and is never triggered by any automated path.

entries.label: Download Mode (Odin)
entries.refusal_reason: NO_FLASH_INVARIANT — Download Mode exists only to flash, and this mission performs no flashing of any kind (no Heimdall/Odin/wrappers, no partition writes).
entries.note: Present for completeness and offline-tested as a refusal; never triggered.
